newsitem.title: USA: Texaco Louisiana crude pipeline reopened.
newsitem.headline: Texaco Louisiana crude pipeline reopened.

text.p: Texaco Inc's 120,000 barrel per day Eugene Island oil pipeline that ruptured last Friday was reopened on Wednesday, the U.S. Coast Guard said on Thursday.
"Texaco's damaged oil pipeline was successfully repaired and began accepting crude oil late Wednesday from various production facilities in the Gulf of Mexico," the Coast Guard said.
The pipeline serves 47 offshore facilities, which were notified late Wednesday they could resume production, the Coast Guard said.

About 150 workers continued to skim pockets of oil that leaked into marshes adjacent to Lake Barre in lower Terrebonne Parish, about 40 miles southwest of New Orleans, when the pipeline ruptured, the Coast Guard said.
Oyster beds in the area remained closed and fishing and shrimping are temporarily prohibited in areas affected by the spill, the Coast Guard said.
